sections.changelog: 2.37.1: zero-friction r1. The theme's own redirect engine (exact legacy-path map on init, old-slug map on template_redirect) is unhooked by the plugin; two orphaned shortcodes render empty; Justice Ops native auto-update enabled once (owner order: no more manual update clicks). 2.37.0: zero-friction (owner order 2026-09-03). All content redirects off: WordPress old-slug redirects, 404 permalink guessing, and the legacy 301 map are disabled; unknown URLs answer 404 (canonical host/https redirects stay). Plugin now loads only 19 modules: protection, update control, registration/advertise, lead router, scheduler, sponsored cards, title/claims guards, practice-hub rendering, internal links, calculators, document/rent/divorce generators, malpractice checker. 36 modules unloaded (AI layer, engines, monitors, e-mail senders, content bridges, maps, cockpit, imports). Status routes: /justice-ops/v1/redirects-off, /justice-ops/v1/cleanup-2026-09. 2.36.0 = cleanup-v1; 2.35.19 = phase-1 recovery release.
